breaking_news.headline: AI giant Anthropic's shares pop in debut after blockbuster IPO
breaking_news.summary: Shares in the AI juggernaut Anthropic are now trading on the stock market. They debuted Thursday, after a record-breaking IPO.

breaking_news.headline: How exactly did Trump get so rich on crypto? We explain
breaking_news.summary: President Trump has made billions of dollars in his second term — most of it in cryptocurrencies. Democrats are vowing to probe his businesses as they gear up to take over Congress next year.

breaking_news.headline: Critics are worried about Anthropic's influence after first day of public trading
breaking_news.summary: Anthropic's initial public offering was a success for shareholders, including its founders. But there were also protests about whether the company can be a responsible steward of AI technology.

breaking_news.headline: Just how vulnerable are we to cyberattacks?
breaking_news.summary: In a week of outages, we're thinking about the rising threat of AI-powered cyberattacks. But sometimes, it's not the most sophisticated attack that's concerning, but the easy targets buried in old software.

breaking_news.headline: Trump's impact on an Ohio steel plant
breaking_news.summary: The giant steel plant in Middletown, Ohio planned to switch away from using coke, a refined form of coal. The switch would have cut hazardous air pollution -- and greenhouse gas emissions. But that plan has changed under President Trump

breaking_news.headline: S&P 500 sinks 3.7% and the Nasdaq composite goes negative for the year
breaking_news.summary: AI stocks have hefty market values and have a much bigger impact on the market's direction. They were responsible for Wall Street's big gains this year and are now behind the big slide for the market.

breaking_news.headline: The AI boom had a really bad week — and it's raising loud alarms
breaking_news.summary: AI stocks — and the broader markets — got pummeled this week, raising major concerns about the financial system and the wider economy. Here's what to know.

breaking_news.headline: Anthropic says it will put humanity first. Will its IPO change that?
breaking_news.summary: Critics say now that the AI giant is a public company, its commitment to put safety ahead of commercial success will be tested.

breaking_news.headline: Lock of former US President George Washington's hair sells for $4,000
breaking_news.summary: The hair was given as a sign of friendship shortly before Washington's death in 1799, according to a descendent of its former owner.

breaking_news.headline: Man convicted of starting Palisades fire in Los Angeles
breaking_news.summary: The 30-year-old LA resident was convicted of arson leading to wildfires that killed 12 people and destroyed more than 6,800 buildings.

breaking_news.headline: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to assassinate US-Ukrainian rapper
breaking_news.summary: The Russian embassy in Denmark has denied the allegation, which has led to Russia's defence attaché being expelled.

breaking_news.headline: FBI reportedly investigating apparent hack of its criminal database
breaking_news.summary: The National Crime Information Center database is used by federal and local law enforcement to share information.

breaking_news.headline: Mexican drug lord on FBI's 10 most wanted list arrested in shoot-out
breaking_news.summary: Fausto Isidro "Chapo Idisro" Meza Flores, who is accused of drug trafficking and torture, is detained after gun fight with authorities.

breaking_news.headline: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock
breaking_news.summary: Countries from nearly 200 countries are in a deadlock to try and get a new global climate agreement.

breaking_news.headline: Russia-bound ship attacked in Gulf of Finland
breaking_news.summary: Finnish defence forces say that Ukraine was likely behind the drone attack on the vessel.
